rationale: Quinbrook identifies GlidePath as the manager-level portfolio company and Prospect as its project. Direct company, court, Texas and ERCOT evidence ties Prospect and West Columbia Storage LLC to GlidePath, with no separate sponsor mandate, co-owner, later equity transfer or pending sale.
recommendedChanges: Merge/remove the standalone Prospect Storage PortCo record into GlidePath Power Solutions.
Preserve Prospect Storage, Prospect Energy Storage and West Columbia Storage LLC as one project/SPV identity beneath GlidePath.
Preserve the West Columbia location, 9.9 MW/9.9 MWh capacity, June 2019 greenfield construction and December 12, 2019 in-service date.
Treat 2019 as project development and operating history, not a third-party acquisition closing.
Do not treat Powin, Habitat, ERCOT or undisclosed financing parties as owners.
unresolvedQuestions: The exact SPV formation and member date are not publicly disclosed.
The current fund holding entity and Quinbrook percentage above GlidePath are not publicly disclosed.
Project lenders and the current optimizer are not publicly disclosed.
fieldCorrections: Do not represent 2019 as a purchase closing; direct evidence describes Prospect as a GlidePath greenfield development.
